name: How long does it take to build a tiny home for a rental unit?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a tiny home for a rental unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building a rental tiny home, particularly an ADU, typically spans several months. This includes initial design and planning (1-2 months), permit acquisition (2-4 months, varying by municipality like Carlsbad or Oceanside), and the actual construction phase (3-6 months). Factors like custom design complexity, material availability, and inspection schedules can influence the overall duration. We provide a projected timeline after finalizing the design and scope of your project, aiming for efficient completion without compromising quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Building a rental tiny home, especially an ADU, generally takes 6-12 months, including design, permit acquisition (2-4 months), and construction (3-6 months).
